about: What GitHub shows in the repository's About box: the line under its name, the website and the topics. A change is a pull request to this file; once it merges, the Desk runs scripts/deploy/Set-RepoAbout.ps1, which starts github-admin.yml in the private ops repository (#4013), and that has the box's admin service (scripts/vps/admin/admin.js, repo-about) make GitHub match it. Set by Patrick's A on 26 Oct 2026 (#3682). The social preview picture is not here: GitHub has no API for it.
description: A roleplay server for Skyrim Special Edition on SkyMP, with its own launcher, website, Discord bot and voice.
